title: How to share a Post on Instagram Stories
description: We know people share posts to their communities on other social media apps, and we’ve made it easier for people to share posts on Instagram Stories.

title: How to share a Post on Instagram Stories

runs: Make sure you have the Instagram app installed on your device. Log into your account.
Open up >x< for iOS app. Tap the share icon on a public Post.
A protected Post cannot be shared.
Your >x< for iOS app will close, and a new Story draft on your Instagram app will open.
The Post you want to share will appear as a moveable and resizable sticker to share on Instagram Stories.
You can share the Post with a single person, a group, or all of your followers.
